subject: E-Commerce
title: Amazon's Antitrust Reckoning
description: A fast breakdown of Amazon's Antitrust Reckoning for builders.

hook.text: The FTC sued Amazon in 2023 for antitrust violations. The case could reshape how all marketplaces operate.

buildup.text: The FTC alleges Amazon punishes sellers who offer lower prices elsewhere and forces them into expensive FBA services.

discovery.text: Amazon's 'fair pricing' policy effectively prevents sellers from listing lower prices on their own websites.

twist.text: If Amazon loses, every marketplace's policies could change. The case has implications far beyond one company.

climax.text: The antitrust case is the biggest legal challenge to marketplace power in e-commerce history. The outcome matters.

punchline.text: FTC vs Amazon. The case that could rewrite marketplace power rules.

quiz.question: What is the core allegation in the FTC's case against Amazon?
options: Amazon punishes sellers who offer lower prices elsewhere and forces expensive services
